RIMEDANCERMOD-FLOURISH.description:
Add a random card from your [gold]Bag of Tricks[/gold] to your hand.
If your [gold]Bag of Tricks[/gold] is empty, first move all [gold]Spells[/gold] outside your hand to it.
RIMEDANCERMOD-FLOURISH.title: Flourish
RIMEDANCERMOD-DEPLOY.description:
Deploys the listed trap.
If you already have an active trap it gets that much [gold]Block[/gold]
RIMEDANCERMOD-DEPLOY.title: Deploy
RIMEDANCERMOD-FIRE.title: Fire X
RIMEDANCERMOD-EXPLOIT.description: A bonus effect if the target of this cards effects has a listed debuff.
RIMEDANCERMOD-EXPLOIT.title: Exploit X
RIMEDANCERMOD-AIMED.description:
Will be targeted by your [gold]Icicles[/gold].
The last enemy you targeted with a card is automatically [gold]Aimed[/gold].
RIMEDANCERMOD-AIMED.title: Aimed
RIMEDANCERMOD-ENCODE.description: [gold]Encoding[/gold] an orb puts it into the enemy's first empty slot. if it has no empty slots their first Orb is automatically [gold]Decoded[/gold] to make room.
RIMEDANCERMOD-ENCODE.title: Encode
RIMEDANCERMOD-DECODE.description: Consume the enemy's rightmost Orb and use its [gold]Decode[/gold] effect.
RIMEDANCERMOD-DECODE.title: Decode
RIMEDANCERMOD-CIPHER.description: When played [gold]Encodes[/gold] as orb with this cards effects on this cards target until it is [gold]Decoded[/gold].
RIMEDANCERMOD-CIPHER.title: Cipher
